title: T5 v1.1 XXL encoder (24 blocks, 4096 wide, 32128 tokens), FLUX.1's long text encoder

provenance.source: safetensors header of diffusion_models/flux1-schnell-fp8.safetensors (17236328572 bytes) on the reference target (ComfyUI Desktop 0.44.0 on port 8188, GAPS Q17), its text_encoders.t5xxl.transformer tensors
provenance.note: No stand-alone T5 XXL file is installed on the reference target, so the names are the embedded encoder's with the text_encoders.t5xxl.transformer. prefix removed: shared.weight [32128, 4096], encoder.block.0 to 23, and a relative_attention_bias in block 0 only. Not yet checked against a stand-alone t5xxl_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors header; a file whose names differ matches no rule and stays unknown.

provenance.source: safetensors header of text_encoders/umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors (6735906897 bytes) on the reference target (ComfyUI Desktop 0.44.0 on port 8188, GAPS Q17)
provenance.note: The contrast: UMT5 XXL (Wan's encoder) has the same block layout but shared.weight [256384, 4096] and a relative_attention_bias in every block, so it doesn't match.
